## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `EditorDebugging`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `editor`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **EditorDebugging**.

## Step 2: Set a breakpoint

1. <!-- manual: Open the integration in the visual designer. -->
2. <!-- manual: Click the three-dot menu on the node where you want to pause. -->
3. Select **Add Breakpoint**.
